title: Carrova recipe (schema v3)
description: Declarative description of one app: how to detect it and which items (files/dirs) can move. Data only: no code, no commands, no absolute paths. Paths are (semantic root, relative path) pairs. v3 adds item-level `os` (per-OS replacements for `paths` / `exclude`, slot-aligned with `paths`), plugin handlers (`handler: { plugin: <id> }`) and recipes for any OS (detection rules for at least one OS; `linux` is no longer required). The Rust loader (carrova-recipe) applies additional semantic checks this schema cannot express: unique item ids, unique recipe ids across the tree, category == parent dir name, app dir name == id, exclude globs must compile, each `os.<os>.paths` has as many entries as `paths`, sensitive paths are excluded from non-sensitive items on every OS.

schema.description: Recipe schema version. Must be 3 for this schema (older recipes validate against recipe.v1.json / recipe.v2.json).

id.description: App id, lowercase kebab-case, unique across all recipes. Must equal the app directory name.

category.description: Category, lowercase kebab-case. Must equal the parent directory name (recipes/<category>/<id>/).

detect.description: Detection rules per OS. The app is detected if ANY rule for the current OS matches; the recipe applies on an OS iff it has rules for it. At least one OS must have rules.

processes.description: Extra process names (daemons, helpers) that count as the app running for `requires_closed` items, in addition to the `binary` detect rules. Bare names, no path separators.

items.description: Selectable items. Item ids must be unique within the recipe (checked by the loader).

bareName.description: Executable or process name: not empty, no `/`, `\` or NUL.

handler.description: A built-in handler by name (gpg-keyring: GnuPG public keys + ownertrust via `gpg --export` / `--import`) or a WASM plugin from the signed recipe bundle (`{ plugin: <id> }`).

pluginId.description: Plugin id: 1 to 64 characters of `a-z`, `0-9` and `-`.

semanticRoot.description: OS-neutral anchor resolved by the platform adapter.

relPath.description: Path relative to a semantic root. `/` separators; no leading `/` or `~`, no backslash, no NUL, no `:` (drive letter) anywhere, no `..` component, not empty (after dropping `.` components).

osPaths.description: An item's paths on one OS. `paths` replaces the base `paths` slot by slot: entry i is where the data of base `paths[i]` lives on this OS, so both lists have the same length (checked by the loader). `exclude`, when present, replaces the base `exclude` (`[]` = none); absent = inherit.

windowsRelPath.description: `relPath` inside a `windows` block (`os.windows`, `detect.windows`): `\` is also a separator (normalised to `/`). Still no leading separator or `~`, no `:` anywhere (drive letter `C:`, even after the first component), no UNC, no NUL, no `..` component, not empty; use a semantic root instead of an absolute path.

windowsOsPaths.description: `osPaths` for the `windows` block, whose `rel` values may use `\` separators.

detectRule.description: Exactly one of `binary` (bare executable name looked up on the search path) or `path` (exists, any kind, symlinks not followed).

flags.description: All fields optional. Defaults: portability=same_os, sensitive=false, requires_closed=false, default=true — except that sensitive and unmovable items default to OFF, and an explicit `default: true` on them is rejected.

portability.description: same_os: only restorable on the same OS family. cross_os: OS-neutral content. v1: everything is same_os.

sensitive.description: Secrets (keys, tokens, credential stores). Off by default and needs explicit confirmation.

requires_closed.description: The app must not be running while this item is captured/applied (databases, lock files).

default.description: Pre-selected in the picker. Effective default: true, or false when sensitive/unmovable.

paths.description: Files/dirs that make up the item (for handler items: the files the handler mutates). Required (non-empty) unless the item is unmovable.

exclude.description: Globs (`*` does not cross `/`, `**` does) matched against the path relative to the item path and relative to the semantic root. A matching directory excludes its subtree.

unmovable.description: Reason the item cannot move (e.g. OS-bound secret). Shown greyed out, never captured.

handler.description: Capture/apply via this handler instead of copying raw files. `paths` then declare the files the handler mutates on the receiver (dry-run plan + rollback backup). Not allowed on unmovable items.

os.description: Per-OS replacements for `paths` / `exclude`. An OS without an entry uses the base values.
